Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND (bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state) IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (11) AND bs.applicability = true AND bs.state = 'CO' GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade)) = 1) AND bs.state = 'CO' AND bs.bldg_id IN (46369, 46370, 46381, 46382, 46803, 46813, 46897, 46898)) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/765e3b63243c13eefb77f97a444be97bb1a0813fc842920a2a1055e277ea1ddd/32484b43-7b37-459a-a0de-2566e27f644b/'
